sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Randhir Singh
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Randhir Singh, learned counsel for the informant as
well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2.  In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that on the false pretext of marriage, the applicant used to talk with the victim for the last four years and had formed physical relations and lastly on 25.10.2023 physical relation was also formed, subsequently it was revealed that the applicant was married somewhere else.
Similar statement was also recorded under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C.
The age of the victim is around 30 years.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 26.10.2023.

sentences.text: 3. Learned A.G.A. as well as the learned counsel for the informant opposed the bail prayer.
4. Considering the fact that admittedly the applicant and the victim knew each other for the last four years and physical relations were also formed allegedly on the false pretext of marriage.

In view of the law as explained in the case of Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana, AIR 2013 SC 2071 a case for bail is made out particular when the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 26.10.2023.

entities.text: Deepak Gulati Versus of State of Haryana, AIR 2013 SC 2071
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Abdul Raees @ Danish be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 126 of 2023,
under Section 376 IPC, Police Station Qaiserbagh, District Lucknow, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 Arun  Abdul Raees @ Danish vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Homes ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86643219/
